mostWorthwhile.text: Building the turning and tilt sensors was worthwhile because the pictures showed how moving fluid and a weighted layer bend sensory hairs in different situations.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the nerve routes felt more like assembly than a new discovery; the pictures showed where they led, but added less about how they worked.

surprise.text: I expected to connect the sensors to the body first, but the compatibility hint connected the eye and posture routes first. The final result also noted that vision and muscle and joint signals help with balance.

arbitrary.text: The required connection order at step 5 was not obvious to me: the sensor nerves appeared to lead toward the body's brain, but the game required the response routes first.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose another chapter: seeing how the separate sensors lead to steady eyes made me curious about other body connections, though some of the route assembly was predictable.
